baseline.exception: An AVPlayerItem cannot be associated with more than one instance of AVPlayer

causalFinding: Reusing the warm-pool AVPlayerItem in the viewer triggers the exact AVFoundation exclusive-player ownership exception. Asset-only preparation and a fresh viewer-owned AVPlayerItem remove this reproduced failure.
limits: Actual UIKit/AVFoundation runtime, with Expo UIView/event adapter rather than the full React Native bridge
Simulator verification is not physical-device or production-backend acceptance
Playback frame events verify requested URL/item identity and trim; fixtures use identical media bytes and do not assert distinct visual pixels
Runtime durations describe test execution only, not application performance targets
